blocks.text: Liza Soberano was among the head-turners at the 2026 Governors Awards, joining some of Hollywood’s biggest stars on the red carpet of the annual Academy-hosted ceremony in Los Angeles, California, over the weekend. Soberano wore a powder-blue, floor-length gown by designer Yara Shoemaker. The dress featured an asymmetrical corset-style bodice with feather detailing, floral embellishments, sequins, and cascading blue beads. The Filipina actress shared the red carpet with prominent Hollywood personalities, including Zendaya, Tom Holland, Charlize Theron, Emma Stone, Timothée Chalamet, Andrew Garfield, Pedro Pascal, Florence Pugh, and Glenn Close.
